name: org-apache-tinkerpop-gremlin
description: org-apache-tinkerpop-gremlin -- transitive npm dep of kotoba-lang/arrangement (via kotobase-query), needed to load arrangement.core under nbb (multiformats.core's @noble/hashes/sha2.js use).
